text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"more developed body paragraphs with multiple supporting examples","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its ideas with fuller explanation and several points that are expanded rather than just stated."},{"evidence":"specific discussion of one-on-one help, visual learners, and class time","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay builds claims with more detailed reasoning and more fully worked-out support."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like 'A teachers main job...' and 'This club makes students know...'","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is organized into clearer paragraphs that each focus on a distinct subpoint."},{"evidence":"sequence of claims across benefits to teachers, students, and parents","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay moves through its points in a more connected and easy-to-follow way."},{"evidence":"phrases such as 'proffered way,' 'quite and not distracting,' and 'wouldnt you want to go be a part of the club too?'","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat better control of sentence flow and structure, even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"less repetitive use of 'example' and 'influence' compared with the other essay","quality":"word choice variety","description":"The essay uses a somewhat broader range of wording to express its ideas."}]}
